whyNotAnHttpServer: The historical terminal READY_FOR_OPERATOR_API named CLASSIFIER_OPERATOR_API_V1. The owner's architecture audit established that browser-facing HTTP transport already belongs to the separate Operator repository (its Fastify /api/v1 layer). A second HTTP server in the engine would duplicate that transport and split ownership. The smallest engine-owned prerequisite was therefore a stable, versioned, machine-readable contract around the classifier capabilities that already exist, invoked as a process; that is what this slice builds, and nothing else.

envelope.contractVersion: exactly 'nwf-pe.classifier-operator.v1'; a caller MUST reject anything else
envelope.outcome: SUCCEEDED | REFUSED | NOT_FOUND | NOT_COMPLETED | FAILED, derived from code
envelope.exitCode: 0 | 1, derived from outcome; always equal to the process exit status
envelope.data: the landed action report or read model, unchanged, or null
envelope.reason: a bounded discriminated object (kind = the code) with ids, enum values, counts and option names only, or null

operationInvocations.UNRESOLVED: an `orgunits classify ... --json` invocation that never resolved to one of the four (unknown read subcommand, CLI usage rejection)

canonicalInvocationForm: argv[0] = 'orgunits', argv[1] = 'classify', then options and (for reads) the read subcommand; '--json' anywhere. Only this form gets a CLI_USAGE_REJECTED envelope for a strict-parse failure.
assemblyRefusalMapping: by exception CLASS (src/orgunits/classify/errors.ts), never by message; OrganisationNotFoundError -> ORGANISATION_NOT_FOUND, ResearchRunNotFoundError -> RESEARCH_RUN_NOT_FOUND, the six others -> CLASSIFIER_ASSEMBLY_REFUSED with their own .code; any untyped planning exception is INTERNAL_ERROR under --json and stays the landed 'classifier assembly refused' text in human mode

actionOutcomeMapping.argument missing or malformed (organisat: INVALID_ARGUMENT, reason {argument, problem: MISSING|MALFORMED}, zero pools
actionOutcomeMapping.research run FAILED / ABORTED / no compl: RESEARCH_RUN_NOT_COMPLETED, reason {runId, researchRunStatus, researchRunErrorKind}, classifier pool never opened
actionOutcomeMapping.research run absent at assembly: RESEARCH_RUN_NOT_FOUND (in practice the completion gate answers NO_COMPLETION_RECORDED first)
actionOutcomeMapping.DRY_RUN, execution would be permitted to: DRY_RUN_EXECUTION_PERMITTED, exit 0, data = the landed dry-run report
actionOutcomeMapping.DRY_RUN, execution would NOT be permitte: DRY_RUN_EXECUTION_NOT_PERMITTED, exit 1, data = the full landed dry-run report, reason {blockedBy: PREFLIGHT_REFUSED and/or ATTEMPT_ALREADY_EXISTS_NON_COMPLETED}
actionOutcomeMapping.EXECUTE, any batch at this attempt exist: ATTEMPT_ALREADY_EXISTS_NON_COMPLETED, exit 1, data null, reason {attemptNo, batches[{batchIndex, persistedState, existingCallId, existingErrorKind}]}, no provider, no write
actionOutcomeMapping.EXECUTE, every batch COMPLETED (executed: EXECUTE_COMPLETED, exit 0, data.batches[].kind EXECUTED|REUSED; full reuse constructs no provider
actionOutcomeMapping.EXECUTE, persisted, at least one batch P: EXECUTE_NOT_COMPLETED, exit 1, data = the landed execution report with each batch's terminalState and errorKind; rows kept as written, nothing retried
actionOutcomeMapping.EXECUTE, runtime batch count differs fro: RUNTIME_RESULT_MISMATCH, exit 1, reason {plannedBatchCount, returnedBatchCount, classifierWritesMayHaveOccurred: true}

readOutcomeMapping.runs / calls / show found: READ_SUCCEEDED, exit 0, data = the landed read model unchanged (ATTRIBUTABLE_ONLY runs, ordinary-only calls, ordinary or repair detail with ADR 0011 effective view)
readOutcomeMapping.a calls run filter that matches nothing: READ_SUCCEEDED with an empty list (unchanged landed semantics: never a claim the run does not exist)

stdoutRule: under --json, every handled outcome of every classifier operation writes exactly one JSON document followed by one newline to stdout and nothing else; no human prefix, suffix or log line
stderrRule: stderr carries only the landed human diagnostics (unchanged text, written in both modes) and, for INTERNAL_ERROR, one diagnostic line; stderr is never part of the contract and a caller never needs to parse it
exitRule: the process exit status equals envelope.exitCode: 0 iff outcome SUCCEEDED, otherwise 1
outOfContract: invocations not of the canonical form (argv not starting 'orgunits classify') or without --json
a crash of the Node process itself (exit non-zero, empty or partial stdout): a caller treats stdout that is not exactly one parseable envelope as a transport failure
preservedQuirk: the action route still ignores a well-formed option it does not use (e.g. a positive --limit or --call-id), exactly as landed; a malformed --limit is still refused, now as INVALID_ARGUMENT
humanModeCompatibility: non-JSON stdout and stderr text, exit codes and exception propagation are unchanged; human and JSON rendering share one decided code per outcome

disclosureBoundary.envelopeReasonCarries: ids, enum values, counts, option names, and the landed preflight detail (which names variables/fields, never their values)
neverInMachineOutput: raw main_text or complete page text
disclosureBoundary.unchangedAuthorisedVisibility: show still exposes the persisted validated rationale, evidence spans and bounded page context exactly as the read-model slice authorised; the action report still never carries model rationale

handoff.invocation: spawn `node dist/cli/index.js orgunits classify ... --json` (after `npm run build`; the caller supplies the environment) or `node --env-file-if-exists=.env --import tsx src/cli/index.ts orgunits classify ... --json`, from the engine repository root; parse stdout as one JSON document; check contractVersion first. Do NOT wrap it in a plain `npm run cli`: npm writes its own banner to stdout (use `npm run --silent cli -- ...` if npm is required)

environmentRequirements.CLASSIFY (dry run and execute): DATABASE_URL_RESEARCH (completion gate) and DATABASE_URL_CLASSIFIER (assembly, identity, persistence)
environmentRequirements.CLASSIFY --execute additionally: the owner's dedicated Claude Max classifier profile (NWF_PE_CLASSIFIER_CONFIG_DIR as an absolute path, or the default <home>/.claude-nwf-classifier) and NO conflicting auth/provider-routing variable and no setup-token variable (ADR 0009/0010); the provider's own preflight still runs

effects.DRY_RUN: reads only; no provider constructed, no classifier write
effects.EXECUTE: may construct the provider (only when a batch needs a NEW call) and append classifier call/completion/classification rows; never retries, never increments the attempt, repair DISABLED
effects.reads: readonly role; zero writes; zero provider calls
